title: Spec of a small colimit of rings is the limit of the spectra
statement: Let $\mathcal I$ be a small category and $D:\mathcal I\to\mathbf{CRing}$ a diagram of commutative rings with colimit $C=\varinjlim_{\mathcal I}D$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The ring maps $D(i)\to C$ induce a cone from the affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] to the inverse diagram of affine schemes $\operatorname{Spec}D(i)$, and this cone is a limit in the category of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Equivalently, after viewing $D$ as a functor $\mathcal I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathbf{CRing}^{\mathrm{op}}$, the affine spectrum functor carries the colimit cocone to a limit cone.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01YW (lemma-directed-inverse-system-affine-schemes-has-limit), with the affine scheme–ring anti-equivalence generalized to an arbitrary small diagram
